title: Paper White 2: the screens that art can replace, res/paperwhite2/art/targets.json
description: The 2D screens of res/ that tools/paperwhite2/screen_art.py (and the editor's Graphics & Palettes) can replace with art from an image editor: each target is one palette and the screens drawn with it, whose tiles, screen resources and colors it rewrites together. Nothing in the game reads this file; the files it names are the game's.

description.description: Where the game shows it, and anything to know before replacing it

palette.description: The palette the screens are drawn with

colors.description: The palette's number of colors when it is a new file; 16 by default in 16-color mode, 256 in 256-color mode

depth.description: 4 for 16-color tiles, each tile using one palette row; 8 for 256-color tiles

rows.description: In 16-color mode, the palette rows the art may use; every row of the palette by default. Leave out rows the game uses elsewhere

max_tiles.description: The most different tiles the screens' character sheet may have, from the game's VRAM layout for them; 1024 by default

chars.description: Its character sheet; screens naming the same one share its tiles
